STARLINK IS BRINGING THE WORLD’S KNOWLEDGE TO THE UNDERSERVED

For the first time in human history, high-speed internet is reaching the most remote and underserved communities on Earth — places that have never had reliable connectivity.

Kids in rural Kenya, remote islands in Haiti, mountain villages in Bolivia, and countless other disconnected regions are now getting access to education, information, and opportunity that was previously impossible.
This is more than just internet.

It’s one of the most powerful tools ever created for lifting people out of poverty.
Elon Musk on why connectivity matters so much:

“The single biggest thing you can do to lift people out of poverty is giving them an internet connection because once you have the internet connection, you can learn anything for free on the internet.”

YOU CAN’T HATE THE MEDIA ENOUGH

For years, legacy media has pushed some of the most hateful, misleading, and outright false narratives about Elon Musk. 

These aren’t honest mistakes — they’re coordinated smears designed to destroy someone who challenges their power.

Here are some of the worst examples from recent years:
•  “Elon Musk appears to make fascist salute at Trump inauguration rally” (Haaretz, The Guardian, PBS, and others — Jan 2025) It was a clear “my heart goes out to you” gesture. Even the ADL initially said it was not a Nazi salute.
•  “Elon Musk grew up wealthy from an apartheid emerald mine” Repeated for years across multiple outlets. His father had a small, short-term stake in a Zambian operation. Elon left South Africa at 17 with almost nothing.
•  “Musk and X are epicenter of US election misinformation” (Reuters, LA Times, and others — 2024) Framed as fact while ignoring that Community Notes and open discourse exposed more lies than legacy media ever did.
•  “Elon Musk is spreading US election lies” (DW News, NBC, and others) Often based on opinion, not evidence.
•  “Elon Musk’s powerful disinformation machine” (EDMO and various outlets — 2025)
These headlines aren’t journalism.
They’re character assassination dressed up as news.




Elon Musk (@elonmusk)

TESLA’S NEXT-GEN OPTIMUS V3 HAND IS GETTING CLOSE TO HUMAN-LEVEL

Tesla engineers just shared new details on the Optimus V3 hand — and the progress is striking.

They’re now saying that as they move into Gen-3 and mass production, the hand is getting very close to human functionality and form factor.

One engineer described it clearly:
“It won’t even look like a robot. It will look like a human in a superhero suit. It will be something revolutionary.”
This level of dexterity and human-like design is a critical milestone. The hand is one of the hardest parts of building a truly useful humanoid robot — and Tesla is iterating extremely fast.

Video

TESLA WAS FOUNDED 23 YEARS AGO TODAY

On July 1, 2003, Tesla Motors was born with a simple but radical mission: accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy by making electric cars desirable — not just good electric cars, but the best cars period.

What started as a small team building the Roadster has become the most valuable car company on Earth.

The journey was brutal:
•  Near bankruptcy multiple times in 2008
•  “Production hell” with the Model 3
•  Constant attacks from legacy auto, media, and short sellers
•  Survived and scaled anyway
Tesla didn’t win by playing it safe. It won by refusing to quit on a mission bigger than any single obstacle.
